{{Quote|We forge this city in the heat of twin suns, in memory of our forefathers, in honor of our living clans, and in hope for our children yet unborn.|translated=1|Historical marker in Mos Espa (translated from [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]])|<ref name="SoT" />}}
'''Mos Espa''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was the home of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]] and [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker]] and also held the famous [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]], at which the annual [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] was held, and the location of [[Wald's Parts|Watto's shop]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Mos_Espa.png|thumb|left|275px|The streets of Mos Espa]]
Mos Espa was an expansive [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and rested near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. It consisted of the dome-roofed, adobe buildings found in [[City/Legends|cities]] across [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and was said to appear as a great, twisting snake, hunkered down to escape the heat. Most residents either were involved in crime business with the Hutts or were poor shopkeepers and moisture farmers trying to eke out a living in the inhospitable desert. The biggest retail business in Mos Espa seems to have been junk-dealing, and even small dealers like [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] seemed to rake in a substantial amount of money in his [[Wald's Parts|shop]], albeit sometimes unscrupulously. Locals who spoke [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] did so with a distinct accent.

The other major activity in Mos Espa was gambling on the [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] held in the nearby [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Grand Arena]]. The podrace that set Anakin Skywalker free from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] was held at Mos Espa. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] may have had some sort of seasonal residence in the city.

Popular businesses where locals puechased food included the Mos Espa Galactic Food Emporium,<ref>Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine.</ref> while the Racer's Edge Cantina was a popular spot for racing fans and spectactors to find refreshment.<ref>Episode I Adventures 6: The Hunt for Anakin Skywalker</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|Mos Eisley really took off though after the podraces were banned. At the time Mos Espa was the capital of Tatooine, and still is according to the records, but after podracing died, Mos Espa lost a lot of business and Mos Eisley picked up the slack.|[[Mayor/Legends|Mayor]] [[Mikdanyell Guh'rantt]], to a spacer|<ref name="SW Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
[[File:Akims_Munch2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Popular eatery [[Akim's Munch/Legends|Akim's Munch]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]]]
Like most Tatooine settlements, it began as a mining colony. When the mining efforts failed, the dying settlement attracted the criminal [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who took control and turned the city into a thriving yet dangerous spaceport.

It gained a deadly reputation for lethal podraces sponsored by the Hutts to encourage gambling. During the reign of the Hutts, the population consisted mostly of slaves, slavers and poor settlers, not including the large number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who briefly stayed in the city before moving on to the next rock.

The town also boasted at least two local ghost stories: the spooky and mysterious [[Nobot/Legends|Nobot]] and a [[Dusty Duck|strange ship]] left deserted on the outskirts that was believed to be haunted.

Around the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] blockade of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] escorts arrived in Mos Espa seeking a new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. After finding a suitable one in Watto's junk dealership, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] made a deal with the Toydarian to exchange the parts and for freedom for his young slave boy Anakin. The deal went in Qui-Gon's favor, and Anakin came with him to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], marking a pivotal moment in galactic history.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace" />

Years later, when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Tatooine, the podraces were outlawed, and the city lost its illicit reputation and allure. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] left for more lucrative parts unknown.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mos Espa was garrisoned by a large Imperial force that patrolled the city in an effort to crack down [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] insurgents.<ref name="SWG:P6" /><ref name="Crackdown" />

[[File:MosEspa.jpg|200px|thumb|Mos Espa during the Rebellion Era]]
In about [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the town was invaded by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] led by the [[Tusken King]], but they were soon [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|driven out]] by a group of spacers.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes</ref>

An auction was held in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]] for the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]] ''[[Killik Twilight]]''. It was sought by many bidders, in particular [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Quenton]] on behalf of the Galactic Empire and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] on behalf of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was stolen from the auction by [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]]. The Solos, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] with the assistance of a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]], [[Grunts]], searched through Mos Espa for the painting.<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>

===Golden Age===
Since the departure of Jabba, the city gained a new reputation: as a respectable and law-abiding, bustling town. It remained a center of trade on the planet and a welcome rest stop for travelers seeking to trek into the deadly Dune Sea nearby.

==Behind the scenes==
The real-world locations of Mos Espa are in [[Tunisia]]. The sets in [[Oung Jmel]] are still standing. [[Ksar Hadada]], [[Ksar Medenine]] and [[Ksar Ouled Soltane]] were filmed for Mos Espa's [[Slave Quarters Row/Legends|Slave Quarters Row]]. On July 19, 2013, it was reported that the sets will soon be buried under encroaching sand dunes.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-23375344|text=Star Wars home of Anakin Skywalker threatened by dune|author=Simon Redfern|date=2013-07-19|archivedate=20150418165706}}</ref>

In the first printing of ''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]'', Mos Espa is misspelled "Mos Epsa" on page 19.
